sources.imageryCredit: Esri, Vantor, Earthstar Geographics, and the GIS User Community
sources.notes: Road surfaces are triangulated directly between this layout's saved road boundaries. Elevation follows the approximately 27 m terrain raster, not a survey of the road. Curbs are geometry-based illustrations on curved boundaries; their locations, widths, heights and colours are assumed, not extracted from imagery. Banking is unknown. The source is an open route or branch network, without one validated closed driving order. Choose an embedded component route for playback and recording; this network does not represent a single lap. Boundary coordinates and their separate feature-level licence are preserved. Imagery loads externally on demand; no image bytes or meshes are stored.

notes: The operator general circuit plan identifies the outer northern course through the right-angle return before the finish. This follows the closed independent main raceway; the source lap measures 928.7 m. Paddock access and the sports-centre perimeter polygon are excluded. Exact source coordinates are unchanged; historical alignment and direction remain provisional.

measurement.note: Road-edge observations at approximately 18 m intervals on pinned LGLN DOP20 imagery, with centre-point flight inventory dated 2026-03-18. Edges follow the road-side barrier or visible racing pavement/curb boundary, excluding gravel runoff, adjoining aprons, pit access and unused connectors. Open-connection limits and unmeasured intervals are interpolated estimates. Source raster spacing is not survey accuracy; banking is unresolved and rendered curbs remain illustrative

imagery.attribution: LGLN (2026), CC BY 4.0. DOP20 current. Modifications: estimated road borders.

borderInference.note: Road-border estimates reconstructed directly from complete, sparse image measurements on the existing trace cross-sections. All intervals interpolate between image anchors; they are not automatic detections or a continuous edge survey. Every saved edge station and anchor requires pinned-image coverage during authoring. Isolated missing pixels inside the road are not filled or used as boundary evidence. Imagery resolution is not survey accuracy. These borders have not been formally verified.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 27 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. There is no saved GPS start gate; the simulation begins at the first trace coordinate. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

notes: The operator plan names the Joker branch inside the northern final complex. Independently named OSM Joker way 282853377 reconnects exact source nodes to the main raceway. The source lap measures 905.4 m; no paddock or venue perimeter edges are included. Exact source coordinates are unchanged; historical alignment and direction remain provisional.

measurement.note: 84 physical edge observations are shared from the Standard route on the same pinned LGLN DOP20 image, with further observations at the different Joker branch and seam. Centre-point inventory dates this image to 2026-03-18. Limits follow the road-side barrier or visible racing pavement/curb boundary, excluding gravel runoff, adjoining aprons and other branches. Openings and intervals without edge observations remain interpolated route-limit estimates. Raster spacing does not establish survey accuracy; banking is unresolved and curbs illustrative
